video.description:
Welcome to Module 10 of the AZ-400 Microsoft DevOps Engineer Expert Certification Training Course, where you’ll learn how to optimize delivery metrics, deployment analytics, and operational queries to improve software release performance and deployment reliability.

This module focuses on tracking deployment efficiency, monitoring release health, analyzing pipeline performance, and using data-driven insights to strengthen continuous delivery and DevOps operations.

What You’ll Learn in This Module:

Understanding delivery metrics and deployment performance indicators
Measuring deployment frequency, success rates, and recovery time
Monitoring release pipelines and operational deployment healt
